technical_summary: Current infra: multi-tenant SaaS on AWS. Traffic profile: bursty support chat (peak 180 qps), steady embedding index updates (daily batch). Targets: p95 chat <250ms, throughput ~150-200 qps sustained, embedding latency <120ms. Running OpenAI API (text-davinci / gpt-3.5-flavored) with custom prompt wrappers. Concerns: prompt parity (system role handling), function-calling semantics, tokenization/stop-sequence differences causing reranking regressions. Redwood Hosted POC shows promising latency and cost; some output drift on complex multi-turn flows. SE proposed: 1) compatibility shim in client layer, 2) controlled A/B with traffic split and eval harness, 3) Dedicated baseline run for 2 weeks before commit.
poC_plan: Phase 1 (Hosted): 2-week A/B with 10% traffic, use eval set (2k prompts) to quantify BLEU/ROUGE-like signal + custom business scoring. Phase 2 (Dedicated): spin up Dedicated pool, run full load tests, compare throughput/latency/cost, validate no regressions on critical prompt set. Acceptance: <5% regression on rerank delta, p95 latency target met, SSO + audit logging validated.
